title: Integer linear combinations of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity, given tangent comparison (Simon Ch. 6, 3.2(1))
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k] on ℝ^P = Eucl P, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and assume the tangent comparison principle (T) in U: for all Hᵏ-null-measurable M₁, M₂ ⊆ U and all θ₁, θ₂ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ_l(x) ≥ 1 for x ∈ M_l and θ_l Hᵏ-integrable on M_l ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U (l = 1, 2), for Hᵏ⌞(M₁ ∩ M₂)-almost every x, every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P that is a weighted approximate tangent space of (M₁, θ₁) at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7) is also one of (M₂, θ₂) at x (the parent obtains (T) from the sibling iwl_imc_tangent_overlap applied to iwl_weighted_tangent_locality P k and U; this child takes (T) as a hypothesis and does not use that sibling). If X, Y ∈ D_k(U) are integer multiplicity, a, b ∈ ℤ, and Z ∈ D_k(U) satisfies Z(ω) = a·X(ω) + b·Y(ω) for every ω ∈ D^k(U), then Z is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → (∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), M₁ ⊆ U → M₂ ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 1 ≤ θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 1 ≤ θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k M₂ θ₂ x Q) → ∀ (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Z ω = (a : ℝ) * X ω + (b : ℝ) * Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z
